description: OpenPV is a browser-based rooftop-solar planning interface maintained by the OpenPV project. The static website lets users examine building solar potential using three-dimensional shading simulation performed locally in the browser by the separately published simshady package. Users identify a building and panel arrangement; the application displays potential generation and shading for the chosen location and assumptions. Geographic coverage depends on available mapped buildings and terrain; the repository does not establish uniform global coverage or a fixed projection period. AGPL-3.0 source and local deployment instructions are public. A limitation is that interactive screening is not a structural survey, grid-connection approval or guaranteed energy yield, and the underlying map layers have separate rights. OpenPV can support early rooftop-solar infrastructure planning. simshady has its own G7 draft as the reusable simulation engine; the catalogue's model-energyplus is a distinct building-energy model. No building mesh, installer or source archive was downloaded.
